capabilities: Read the current Markdown note aloud with online TTS voices
Control playback with pause, paragraph skipping, retry, and 0.75x-2x speed
Save and restore the last playback position per note
Configure alternative speech providers (Azure, SiliconFlow, Doubao, OpenAI-compatible) with per-session keys
Play randomly selected notes from explicitly allowed folders without repeats
extras: Desktop-only; playback is validated on Windows Obsidian 1.14.4 while macOS/Linux acceptance is pending and Android/iOS are unsupported. A consent dialog precedes any online speech request, keys stay in memory only for the session, and default Edge TTS needs no account or key. Includes a full Chinese-language section and build/release documentation.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to listen to notes read aloud or to review folder contents by audio playback.
